name: tripod_weight_shift_static_v2
description: Tripod weight shift v2: identical 120 s / 10 Hz static tripod weight-shift waveform to tripod_weight_shift_static_v1, re-entered with a DROOP-TOLERANT stand entry. v1 produced zero ticks because the runner's automatic start-pose glide verifies the worst joint within GLIDE_TOL_DEG = 3 deg (a hardcoded sysid_runner constant, not a protocol field) and a 3.4 deg LOADED HIP DROOP at the stand pose exceeded it, so the run aborted before the first segment. v2 uses the same entry mechanism champion_stand_ground_v1 (and _hold90_v1) use on the ground: NO home_deg, so start_pose() is the leading traj's first row = bench zero, the glide is skipped (travel <= 3 deg) and the stand is approached as a streamed ramp under motion rather than snapped to and gated. Seg 0 is a 6 s / 60-tick LINEAR ramp from the bench-zero rest pose (champion_stand_ground_v1 q_deg[0]) into the stand pose, ending exactly on it (worst joint 81.6 deg over 6 s = 13.6 deg/s, ~1.1x the runner's own 12 deg/s glide rate and well under the 220 counts/s ~ 19 deg/s write profile). Seg 1 is the v1 waveform byte-for-byte (6 s stand-pose lead-in, three cycles of 4 s ramp / 5 s hold shifts 6 mm vertical between tripod A (L0/L2/L4) and tripod B (L1/L3/L5), 6 s lead-out) at its v1 start_tol_deg of 12 deg: the 3 deg figure was never this field (v1 already carried 12 deg here), it was GLIDE_TOL_DEG, so the plan's 3 -> 8 deg is taken via the ramp-entry branch instead and the segment-boundary continuity gate is left at the wider 12 deg, which the 3.4 deg loaded droop clears with room to spare. All six feet stay planted; no foot lifts, no yaw moves. 126 s total at 10 Hz. Soft torque 700; loaded current budget 2.0 A tripping after three consecutive readings above it (this is a LOADED WHOLE-BODY trajectory -- three legs carry the full body, the same load class as loaded_stance_droop_map_v1 and champion_stand_ground_hold90_10hz_v1, both of which ran clean at 2.0 A; the 0.9 A it previously carried is the single-leg air/quasi-static budget and rejected a normal 1.07 A stance-leg draw); hard ceiling 3.0 A unchanged. The runner logs cmd{j}_deg and q{j}_deg for all 18 joints every tick, so commanded-vs-actual loaded droop per leg is recoverable at every plateau. Robot ON THE GROUND (unsupported), operator watching, hands ready; requires force=true.
